OriginalScript: Heavy rain’s anticipated. Bolivar Road is at a standstill. South Road is closed at Ashwin Parade for Torrens to Darlington civil works, and there’s road construction on South Road. Old Port Road has moderate delays at Tapleys Hill Road through maintenance, and Main North Road’s under speed with roadworks. There are no toll roads in Adelaide, including the tunnels on South Road — the whole network's free to use. Please stay alert out there and stick to the speed limit.
